name: io.github.gjlmotea/studio-sidecar-for-roblox-studio-mcp
title: Studio Sidecar
description: Companion to Roblox Studio's built-in MCP: open places, guard writes, Open Cloud asset uploads.

environmentVariables.name: ROBLOX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Open Cloud API key with Asset read and write; only the four Open Cloud tools need it

environmentVariables.name: ROBLOX_CREATOR_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Roblox user ID recorded as the creator of uploaded assets

environmentVariables.name: ROBLOX_UPLOAD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Folders that uploads may read from, joined with the platform path delimiter: ';' on Windows (C:\assets\models;D:\decals), ':' on macOS (/Users/you/models:/Volumes/art/decals). Uploads are refused when unset

environmentVariables.name: ROBLOX_STUDIO_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Roblox Studio executable; resolved automatically when unset
